item.title: Build memory-aware AI agents with Agentic Retrieve on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
item.description: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore memory now store conversations, extract facts, and bring long-term memory into a single AgenticRetrieveStream call. This post shows how to build a memory-aware, multi-user assistant where each user sees only the documents they may read and each user's memory stays private. — 来源：arxiv · simonwillison · aws_ml — 原文：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/build-memory-aware-ai-agents-with-agentic-retrieve-on-amazon-bedrock-managed-knowledge-base/

item.title: Taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns, anti-patterns, and lessons from manufacturing
item.description: Multi-agent coordination is a distributed systems problem, not a model problem. item.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
item.description: AI coding agents are increasingly help developers fix bugs and build features largely on their own, but every interaction with their models consumes tokens. In each session, an agent sends instructions, tool descriptions, and session history to its model. Most efforts to reduce this cost focus on individual tasks. Yet developers return to the same […] The post TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient appeared first on Microsoft Research . — 来源：arxiv · microsoft_research — 原文：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/tokeneconomizer-learning-from-experience-to-make-ai-coding-agents-more-efficient/
